name: Datacircle API
description: Find the best GTM APIs. We benchmark all the GTM APIs and we put the results on our website. This API lists every API on our sheet, who is best for each and every plan, free, with no key. Each plan comes with its score out of 100, and the best come first, as on the sheet. No key, no account. At most 60 calls a minute from one address: every plan is one file at https://datacircle.dev/datacircle.json.
